description: Fires the moment a workout reaches the summary screen. Deterministic, instant and offline: this is the layer that must never wait on an API. The LLM layer writes a richer follow-up separately.

variables.headline: {{ km }} km {{ kind }} in {{ mins }} min
variables.body: {{ kcal | round(0) | int }} kcal at {{ pace }} km/h average.{{ hr_bit }} That's {{ week_km | round(1) }} km across {{ week_n }} session(s) this week.
variables.hr_bit: {% if avg_hr | int > 0 %} Heart rate averaged {{ avg_hr }} bpm, peaking at {{ max_hr }}.{% endif %}

data.payload: {{ {'headline': headline, 'body': body, 'kind': 'post_workout', 'source': 'rules', 'km': km, 'mins': mins, 'kcal': kcal | round(0) | int, 'pace': pace, 'avg_hr': avg_hr | int, 'max_hr': max_hr | int} | to_json }}
